title: Principles for effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting
authority_scope: International supervisory principles for systemically important banks; useful as a risk-data contract beyond that mandatory scope.
limitations: Principles do not prescribe a vendor architecture or a complete analytics catalogue.

title: The Basel Framework
supports: credit market operational and liquidity risk
authority_scope: Consolidated international prudential standards for internationally active banks, subject to jurisdictional implementation.
limitations: Effective versions and national transpositions vary by date and jurisdiction.

title: Principles for the Management of Credit Risk
authority_scope: International supervisory credit-risk principles published in 2025.
limitations: High-level principles require portfolio-specific methods and local rules.

title: Final guidelines for counterparty credit risk management
authority_scope: International supervisory guidelines for bank counterparty-credit-risk management.
limitations: Does not replace jurisdiction-specific capital, accounting, or legal-netting requirements.

title: CRE50 Counterparty credit risk definitions and terminology
authority_scope: Normative terminology in the consolidated Basel counterparty-credit-risk framework.
limitations: The cited chapter has versioned effective dates; implementations must pin a version.

title: CRE51 Counterparty credit risk overview
authority_scope: Consolidated Basel rules for identifying and measuring CCR exposures.
limitations: Requires linked CRE52-CRE54 and national implementation for a complete calculation.

title: Interagency Supervisory Guidance on Counterparty Credit Risk Management
publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
authority_scope: US interagency supervisory guidance for banking organizations with material derivatives and securities-financing exposures.
limitations: Older US guidance; current Basel and current agency guidance must also be considered.

title: Stress testing principles
authority_scope: International principles for bank and supervisory stress-testing frameworks.
limitations: High-level principles do not specify every portfolio model.

title: 2026 Stress Test Scenarios
publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
authority_scope: Official 2026 US supervisory stress scenario and counterparty-default component.
limitations: Hypothetical supervisory scenario, not a forecast; US scope and annual vintage.

title: Revised Guidance on Model Risk Management
publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
authority_scope: 2026 US interagency model-risk guidance, superseding SR 11-7 for its stated scope.
limitations: Applicability is risk- and size-sensitive and does not define domain model formulas.

title: Basel III: The Liquidity Coverage Ratio and liquidity risk monitoring tools
authority_scope: International bank liquidity standard integrated into the Basel Framework.
limitations: National implementation and reporting taxonomies vary.

title: Principles for Sound Liquidity Risk Management and Supervision
authority_scope: International supervisory principles for bank liquidity risk.
limitations: Principles require institution-specific calibration.

title: Supervisory guidance for managing risks associated with the settlement of foreign exchange transactions
authority_scope: International supervisory guidance for FX settlement risk.
limitations: Must be combined with current market-infrastructure and local settlement rules.

title: BSA/AML Examination Manual
authority_scope: US interagency BSA/AML examination procedures and risk-management expectations.
limitations: Not a safe-harbor typology library; rules and advisories change.

title: FinCEN Suspicious Activity Report XML Filing Requirements
authority_scope: Official US BSA e-filing XML requirements for SAR submissions.
limitations: Schema does not define upstream alert-scoring logic.

title: Frequently Asked Questions on Advanced Sanctions List Standard
authority_scope: Official US Treasury sanctions-list data formats.
limitations: A list match is not by itself a legal disposition; programs and licenses require expert interpretation.

title: ISO 20022 Message Definitions
supports: payment initiation clearing and settlement messages
authority_scope: Official catalogue of ISO 20022 financial message definitions, schemas, and usage documentation.
limitations: Communities apply usage guidelines and versions differently; message availability is not proof of implementation.

title: Harmonised ISO 20022 data requirements for enhancing cross-border payments - updated report
publisher: Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures
authority_scope: International harmonisation guidance for ISO 20022 cross-border payment implementations through 2027.
limitations: Guidance is not itself a binding payment-scheme rule.

title: Enhancing cross-border payments: addressing fraud
publisher: Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures
authority_scope: 2026 CPMI public-private task-team report on cross-border fast-payment fraud.
limitations: Best-practice report rather than binding rule; implementations require scheme and jurisdiction specifics.

title: 2025 report on payment fraud
publisher: European Banking Authority and European Central Bank
supports: cards credit transfers direct debits cash withdrawals and e-money
authority_scope: Official EEA payment-fraud statistics collected under PSD2 and ECB payment-statistics rules.
limitations: Aggregated EEA supervisory reporting; definitions may not transfer to every scheme or jurisdiction.

title: Federal Reserve Payment Systems and Payments Study
publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
authority_scope: Official US payment-system resources and recurring Federal Reserve Payments Study.
limitations: Aggregate study data is not a substitute for institution-level event telemetry.

title: Home Mortgage Disclosure Act Data
authority_scope: Official public US HMDA loan-level data, privacy-modified for disclosure.
limitations: Public fields are modified for privacy and do not contain the complete underwriting file.

title: Interagency Fair Lending Examination Procedures
authority_scope: US interagency fair-lending examination procedures.
limitations: Legal conclusions require regulator or counsel judgment; statistical disparity alone does not establish causality.

title: Uniform Mortgage Data Program technology integration resources
supports: loan application closing delivery and appraisal datasets
authority_scope: Primary GSE implementation specifications for US single-family mortgage data exchange.
limitations: GSE-specific policies and versions differ; not universal to all lending products.

title: Accounting Standards Update 2016-13 Financial Instruments - Credit Losses
authority_scope: US GAAP expected-credit-loss standard and transition material.
limitations: Detailed authoritative codification access and institution-specific accounting policy are still required.

title: Current Expected Credit Losses resources
authority_scope: US interagency and FDIC CECL implementation resources for insured depository institutions.
limitations: Does not prescribe one mandatory estimation method for every portfolio.

title: Comptroller's Handbook
publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
authority_scope: Current US OCC examination booklets for national banks and federal savings associations.
limitations: Scope and publication dates vary by booklet; pin the relevant booklet version.

title: Guidelines on loan origination and monitoring
authority_scope: In-force EBA guidelines for EU institution loan origination and lifecycle monitoring.
limitations: EU scope; proportionality and national implementation apply.

title: EBA NPL transaction data templates
authority_scope: Official EU NPL transaction data templates and dictionary.
limitations: Templates target NPL transactions and do not cover all performing-loan servicing states.

title: Bank Data Guide - Data Downloads
authority_scope: Official public data for FDIC-insured US institutions, including bulk and API access.
limitations: Quarterly regulatory data is not intraday operational data and can be amended.

title: Rule 613 Consolidated Audit Trail
authority_scope: US NMS consolidated audit-trail rule and implementation references.
limitations: US NMS scope; privacy, funding, and technical requirements continue to evolve.

title: Guidance on Best Execution Obligations in Equity, Options and Fixed Income Markets
authority_scope: US broker-dealer best-execution guidance across named security markets.
limitations: Rule interpretations and current SEC and FINRA amendments must be checked.

title: Trade Reporting Frequently Asked Questions
authority_scope: FINRA implementation guidance for US trade reporting facilities.
limitations: Facility and asset-class requirements differ and change.

title: CFTC Technical Specification: Parts 43 and 45 swap data reporting
authority_scope: Official US swap-data reporting technical specification; implementations must use the current version.
limitations: The linked version is historical and retained as structural evidence; current CFTC versioning is required for production.

title: MiFID II and MiFIR review report on transaction and reference data
authority_scope: EU securities regulator analysis of MiFID II/MiFIR transaction and reference-data reporting.
limitations: Review report is not the complete current delegated-regulation text.

title: FIX Technical Standards
supports: orders executions allocations and market data
authority_scope: Primary industry standards for electronic trading and trade-lifecycle messaging.
limitations: Counterparties negotiate rules of engagement and version profiles.

title: FpML Specifications
authority_scope: Open industry XML specification for derivatives and structured-product processing.
limitations: Product and process coverage varies by FpML view and version.

title: Common Domain Model
authority_scope: Primary industry common domain model for financial-product, trade, and lifecycle events.
limitations: Adoption and product coverage are not universal; governance has moved to FINOS.

title: ISDA SIMM Methodology version 2.8+2512
authority_scope: Current-at-access industry methodology for regulatory initial margin on non-cleared derivatives.
limitations: Licensed methodology with versioned calibration; not a general CCR replacement.

title: Form N-PORT and Form N-CEN Reporting; Guidance on Open-End Fund Liquidity Risk
authority_scope: US registered-fund reporting amendments and liquidity-risk guidance with delayed dates stated by SEC.
limitations: Effective and compliance dates changed; production logic must use current SEC text.

title: Form PF; Reporting Requirements for All Filers and Large Hedge Fund Advisers
authority_scope: US private-fund confidential reporting rule amendments and compliance-date status.
limitations: Confidential regulator form is not a complete internal portfolio-risk model.

title: Form ADV Data
authority_scope: Official public US investment-adviser filing data.
limitations: Multiple tables and narrative PDFs require linkage; state coverage differs.

title: GIPS Standards Handbook for Firms
authority_scope: Global professional standard for fair and comparable investment-performance presentation by claiming firms.
limitations: Voluntary claim of compliance; not a portfolio-risk or suitability standard.

title: FINRA Rule 2111 Suitability
authority_scope: US broker-dealer suitability rule for recommendations not governed by specified alternatives.
limitations: Regulation Best Interest supersedes this rule for covered recommendations; applicability must be classified.

title: Frequently Asked Questions on Regulation Best Interest
authority_scope: SEC staff guidance on US Regulation Best Interest.
limitations: Staff guidance is not the complete rule and fact-specific legal judgment remains necessary.

title: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts
authority_scope: International financial-reporting standard for insurance contracts.
limitations: Full licensed standard and entity accounting policy are required for implementation.

title: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments
authority_scope: International financial-reporting standard for financial instruments.
limitations: Full licensed standard, interpretations, and accounting policy are required.

title: Risk-Based Capital
supports: life health and property-casualty capital formulas
catastrophe mortality longevity and asset risk
authority_scope: US state-insurance model-law and RBC framework overview.
limitations: State adoption and annual formula instructions control; RBC is not a general insurer ranking.

title: ORSA Guidance Manual
authority_scope: US state-insurance ORSA reporting guidance linked to NAIC Model Act 505.
limitations: State law and confidential filing expectations vary.

title: Market Conduct Annual Statement
authority_scope: Uniform US state-insurance market-conduct data collection covering thirteen listed lines at access date.
limitations: Aggregate ratios are screening signals, not findings; definitions vary by MCAS version and line.

title: Schedule P
supports: reserve analysis by line and accident year
authority_scope: US property-casualty statutory Schedule P data product description.
limitations: Ten-year statutory aggregation is insufficient for every actuarial segmentation and operational claim decision.

title: Catastrophe Models - Property
authority_scope: NAIC overview of catastrophe-model use and regulatory work for property insurance.
limitations: Does not specify any proprietary vendor model; historical data alone is explicitly insufficient.

title: Insurance Core Principles and ComFrame
authority_scope: Globally accepted framework for insurance supervision, last updated December 2024 as stated by IAIS.
limitations: Jurisdictional implementation and insurer proportionality vary.

title: Supervisory reporting - DPM and XBRL
publisher: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority
authority_scope: Official EEA insurance and pensions supervisory-reporting taxonomy resources.
limitations: Release entry points, validations, and legal templates are versioned.

title: Methodological principles of insurance stress testing - climate change component
publisher: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority
authority_scope: EIOPA methodological toolbox for insurance climate stress tests.
limitations: Scenario uncertainty is material and horizons extend beyond conventional stress testing.

title: ACORD Global Reinsurance and Large Commercial Standards Generation 2.0
authority_scope: Primary insurance standards-body description of GRLC 2.0 messaging scope.
limitations: Detailed standards access and implementation profiles may require membership or licensing.

title: Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures
authority_scope: International standards for systemically important payment systems, CSDs, SSSs, CCPs, and trade repositories.
limitations: Requires FMI-type applicability and jurisdictional oversight assessment.

title: Level 2 Data: Who Owns Whom
authority_scope: Authoritative Global LEI System relationship-data documentation.
limitations: Accounting-consolidating relationships are not all economic-dependence, control, guarantee, or beneficial-ownership relationships.

title: GLEIF Data Quality Checks
authority_scope: Official LEI data-quality rule-setting and maturity model.
limitations: Passing LEI checks does not establish complete counterparty economic connectedness.

title: TARGET2-Securities overview
authority_scope: Official Eurosystem description of T2S securities-settlement functions.
limitations: Participant and CSD interfaces and penalty rules require current detailed specifications.

title: Personal financial data rights
authority_scope: US CFPB section 1033 rule resources; page records stayed compliance dates and reconsideration status.
limitations: Rule and compliance dates are legally contested and changing; current status must be checked before reliance.

title: The Buy Now, Pay Later Market
authority_scope: Official CFPB analysis of data supplied by six large BNPL firms for 2019-2023.
limitations: Six-firm US sample and lagged observation period; not a complete current market census.

title: Virtual Assets Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing
authority_scope: FATF global AML/CFT typology guidance based on member case studies.
limitations: Red flags are not dispositive and guidance must be read with newer FATF Recommendations and local law.
